method: Targeted PE string, RIP-relative, call and absolute xrefs over the file on disk; every hop confirmed by bounded objdump disassembly of its own range. Scratch tooling was temporary and is not retained.
installs: none; x86_64-w64-mingw32-objdump, strings and Python 3.14.8 stdlib already present
widget_source: Game/Ui/Widgets/Attributes/AtAttribute.cpp, value function RVA 0x3E42F0, Magic Find case RVA 0x3E47F8
attribute_identity: UI attribute 13 maps to no character attribute (RVA 0x3E3F30) and to modifier type 0x71 (RVA 0x3E3E00); name table index 113 is RewardCreatureAll and 114 is RewardCreatureAllBoon; the base comes from ChCliPlayerStats.cpp, which names accountMagicFindTable and accountMagicFindProgress
stored_total_note: ChCliCoreStats.cpp keeps arrays for the 11 character attributes only (indices 1..11, last is FishingPower). The only code that asks for modifier types 0x71 or 0x72 is the attribute widget; no other consumer caches them.
stored_inputs: account luck level: DWORD at ChCliPlayerStats+0x24 (player+0x9700), written by RVA 0x1208B40
server-pushed modifiers: sorted 12-byte records {type, float, source} at buff manager +0xD8, count +0xE4, written only by message handlers RVA 0x12C4730 and 0x12C47D0
applied buffs: hash table at buff manager +0x20 (24-byte buckets), each buff's definition holds 72-byte modifier records
not_read: the display cap, which is a content number fetched by RVA 0x12DD120(0x1C9, 0x1B5)
artifact_format: Hashes of guarded ranges only in profile.json; no bytes of the binary and no live data retained
